review:
A sun-temple Megaways game. Scatters land anywhere, and three to six of them start free spins – more scatters, more spins.

In the bonus, every wild that lands sticks to its reel until the end. On a Megaways grid that adds up fast, with huge ways counts covered in wilds. A Chance option boosts your scatter odds. Very high volatility, 12,960x max and 96.69% RTP. Free spins about once every 259 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
